names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 decembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Gheorghe de la Cernica», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Γεώργιος της Τσερνίκα», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «constatăm că el s-a născut în anul 1730, din părinți credincioși și de bun neam în localitatea Săliște, lângă Sibiu», from the commemoration list he left and from the notes of those who studied his life.

death.note: doxologia.ro quotes the monastery's commemoration list in Calinic's hand: «1806, din decembrie 3: au răposat Părintele Gheorghe, arhimandrit al ăștii obștii».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Γεώργιος της Τσερνίκα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it is the same man: its heading reads «Οσιος Γεωργιος Της Τσερνικα (1730 - 1806)», the two years the folder already holds, and it names Săliște near Sibiu, Paisius Velichkovsky and the skete of Cernica. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).
